scope: Exactly20 chosen unique lecture jobs. Only the chosen final job contributes to each case.
MP4 figures are public CLIP_DOWNLOADED records produced after the primary harness saved and probed each file.
Job success and these runtime facts do not establish title, crop, continuity, teaching completeness, speech accuracy or content quality.
Aggregate MP4 duration is not a source-coverage measure: overlaps, editorial order and omitted ranges require authenticated per-clip EDL review.
Source byte counts, exact duration and SHA256 are null where the public job log did not print them; do not substitute ASR display counters.
Artifact digests identify encrypted outer ZIP transport. Decryption/authenticated inventory and media review are separate.
